response.justification: The candidate is a strong individual-contributor software engineer with broad full-stack, systems, and DLang expertise, but the role requires an executive-level CTO with 5+ years of senior technical leadership, proven production multi-agent AI systems, and a track record scaling engineering orgs from 10 to 30+ people. None of these are evidenced; the candidate has never held a formal leadership title, has no team-scaling history, and only recent, minor exposure to agentic AI tooling (MCP code generators) rather than production multi-agent systems in regulated fintech environments.
strengths: Broad technical versatility across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems
Recent hands-on exposure to AI-agent infrastructure (MCP, agentic frameworks) at re:cinq
Solid fintech-adjacent experience at Optilyz and RIDE Capital with TypeScript/AWS/GraphQL stacks
concerns: No evidence of executive or senior leadership roles managing or scaling engineering teams
No demonstrated production experience building/operating multi-agent AI systems at scale
No track record with regulatory compliance, credit risk systems, or governing outsourced engineering teams

key_factors.factor: No production multi-agent AI system experience
Relevant fintech and full-stack technical background
